_comment: nx is used graph-only here: `nx show projects --affected` answers which .NET projects and which pnpm packages a diff touches (see .github/scripts/affected.sh). Builds and tests still run through dotnet and pnpm; no nx targets are run and nothing is cached.
_sharedGlobals_comment: namedInputs.sharedGlobals: a change to any of these marks every .NET project affected. @nx/dotnet's analyzer already declares them as per-project evaluation inputs (verified: same answer with the list removed); listing them keeps the rule explicit and independent of the plugin. They only reach projects whose targets use the `default` input, i.e. the .NET ones, not frontend/viewer: the frontend lockfile and other non-.NET shared files are handled by .github/scripts/affected.sh instead.
